settings.prompt: An old fisherman with a white beard, wearing a yellow raincoat and a blue wool hat, pushes his small wooden boat into the sea at dawn. He rows across calm water as the sun rises. He casts a fishing net from the boat. In the afternoon he pulls the heavy net full of silver fish. He rows back to the harbor. In the evening he sits by a fire on the beach and cooks a fish.
